name: Shimrath
title: Son of Shimi from the tribe of Benjamin
summary: Shimrath was a son of Shimi and belonged to the tribe of Benjamin. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogies of the Benjamites. He was one of the family heads who lived in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Shimrat is mentioned as one of the sons of Shimi in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, among the heads of families in the tribe.

keyEvents.title: Genealogies of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Shimrat belonged to the Benjamite clans recorded in Chronicles, showing his place in Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Heads of Families in Benjamin
keyEvents.description: As part of the heads of families in Benjamin, Shimrat and his relatives were counted among the leaders of their tribe.

keyEvents.title: Living in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: According to Chronicles, the heads of families from the tribe of Benjamin, including Shimrat's clan, lived in Jerusalem.
